visual_grammar.medium_handling: Full-page codex frontispiece: layered opaque pigment, gold leaf, carved ink bite, indigo vellum depth, lunar glazing, and recurring ankh illumination combined more richly than any minor suit.
visual_grammar.composition: Mythic hieratic plates with strong central/axial structure, architectural or landscape depth where needed, and enough surrounding symbolic world to make each trump feel like a chapter-frontispiece of the Avatar's journey.
visual_grammar.edge_language: Heraldic crispness at sacred/sovereign forms, carved ink at conflict, manuscript precision at wisdom, and soft lunar/glazed edges at passage—combined selectively, never all at equal intensity.
visual_grammar.value_structure: Deep manuscript darks and parchment mids support concentrated gold, moon-silver, phosphor, or clarion highlights according to the trump's governing event.
visual_grammar.camera_and_scale: Iconic to epic: frontal throne/shrine plates, deep quest roads, monumental gates, celestial/cataclysmic vistas, and intimate sacrificial interiors all remain clearly composed as illuminated pages.
visual_grammar.detail_distribution: Highest ornament and specificity cluster around the trump's central relation, ankh/rune/gate/throne motif, and one or two narrative witnesses; peripheries simplify into page-like atmosphere.
visual_grammar.finish: Ornate full-bleed illumination—mythic, materially codex-like, and more integrated than any single suit while preserving each trump's readability.
avoid: uniform gold ornament regardless of meaning

factorization.visual_logic: Leave the Stranger small inside an overwhelmingly open page/land: no suit, virtue, road, or sovereign order has yet organized the field, so potential is visible as unclaimed space.
One initiating figure/gesture becomes the transparent unit of action: a single vertical or forward axis should start the whole page moving without yet multiplying into companions or institutions.
Build the card as one irreducible lunar dyad/threshold: two moons or two sides of passage define a relation that cannot be simplified without losing the crossing itself.
Use a threefold generative root—Truth, Love, Courage—as an irreducible triangle or triadic field from which later virtue-structures visibly descend.
Square the Two Moons into durable architecture: paired thresholds become four-corner enclosure, gate frozen into wall/castle/throne geometry.
Give sovereignty one irreducible axial center: throne, ruler, and realm orient around a single stabilizing line rather than a coalition of equal focal points.
Combine the Moons' dyadic relation with the Principles' triad: companions form a circle/network whose pairwise bonds participate in a larger threefold generative field.
Reduce the Quest to one uncompromising road/vector crossing the page. The act of setting out should be formally indivisible even if companions travel it.
Cube passage through nested thresholds at multiple depths/scales: mastery of the between becomes repeated gate-within-gate organization that risks becoming imprisonment.
Square the Principles inward: one triadic outer order is echoed by a second, smaller inner triad around the Lantern/wise center, turning public virtue into internal illumination.
Let threshold/moon duality rotate around sovereignty's fixed axis: the Wheel should make passage and realm visibly co-dependent as ages turn around a stable center.
One irreducible line of self-governance holds person and wyrm in relation. Strength appears as a singular governing bond rather than accumulated techniques or restraints.
Suspend the Castle's fourfold frame inside the Principles' triadic field and invert its orientation: stable passage is voluntarily relinquished so another order can be perceived through sacrifice.
Make the Black Gate one absolute threshold across the whole page. Everything before/after relates to this indivisible boundary; no sequence of smaller exits should dilute it.
Bring the Moons' two-sided passage into the Quest's singular road: opposing currents/temperatures converge around one measured central path rather than cancelling one another.
Lock the Principles' triadic generation into sovereignty's monolithic axis: many virtuous strands are visibly owned/routed through one false center, making bondage look formally orderly.
Recursively square the threshold/castle frame until repeated enclosure exceeds containment and shatters along its own nested boundaries.
Hold one irreducible shrine/light/opening against damaged ground. Renewal should read as a singular mercy that the ruined structures around it cannot generate by themselves.
Let lunar duality witness the Principles squared through layered reflections, false doubles, or repeated triads; fecundity becomes visually abundant but epistemically unreliable.
Use one indivisible radiant source/field whose clarity organizes the entire page without secondary explanation: justice becomes visible as daylight itself.
Sound sovereignty through the Castle's stable fourfold threshold: a fixed gate/frame becomes a transmitting call across worlds, with concentric or echoed structure extending outward.
Combine the Principles' generative triad with the Quest's irreducible road into a complete moving pattern: many virtues remain distinct yet participate in one integrated circulation around the Codex.
